tool_input.command:
git add internal/daemon/command.go internal/daemon/command_test.go && git commit -m "fix(daemon): thread a logger into LoadCommands, distinguish operational verification failures

Findings 2+3 (code-reviewer, silent-failure-hunter): LoadCommands logged
rejections via the package-level slog default, so the highest-value audit
event this feature produces never reached the daemon's log file, only bare
stderr. LoadCommands and loadCommand now take a *slog.Logger (nil falls
back to slog.Default(), so existing test call sites keep working
unchanged).

Also distinguish a *SignatureError (a definitive signature verdict) from
an operational failure inside VerifySignature's own pipeline (gpg binary
missing/unusable, temp dir creation failing) via a new unexported
verificationError wrapper -- the latter now logs at a distinct Error
level instead of falling into the generic Warn-level 'skip invalid
command file' path an ordinary parse/validation failure takes.

New tests cover: an operational VerifySignature failure while ownerKeyID
!= \"\" produces the distinct Error log, not the generic Warn; a rejection
is observable through an explicitly passed logger and not just the
package default."
tool_input.description: Commit command.go logger threading and verification-error distinction
